title: The First White Mile
description: Pause under cabin roofs, read falling-ice warnings, then cross the open snow. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Monthly sample route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The first white shelter
rooms.lesson: The amber mark warns where ice will fall. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The cabin terraces
rooms.lesson: Jump the snow-covered cabin walls. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The exposed snow road
rooms.lesson: Leave the roof after the ice passes. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: Above the snowline
rooms.lesson: Climb the cabin roofs above the drifting snow. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: Between the fir shelters
rooms.lesson: Cross one exposed opening at a time. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The first frozen stream
rooms.lesson: Brake on stone before the final frozen cuts. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
